rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when people or things separate and go in different directions.

example.english: The crowd began to scatter as soon as they saw the police.
example.traditional: 人群一見到警察就散開喇。
example.jyutping: jan4 kwan4 jat1 gin3 dou2 ging2 caat3 zau6 saan3 hoi1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when loosely sprinkling or distributing something such as salt, ashes, or seeds.

example.english: Scatter some sesame over the noodles before you eat.
example.traditional: 你食之前撒啲芝麻落麵度。
example.jyutping: nei5 sik6 zi1 cin4 saat3 di1 zi1 maa4 lok6 min6 dou6
